recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s-style album cover featuring a central rectangular portrait of a smiling woman in a wide-brimmed hat, framed by a thick black border with two tiers of contrasting typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: A central vertical portrait inset within a dominant black field.
Bold, white, all-caps serif text providing a heavy visual header.
A secondary line of warm-toned, elegant script text for the subtitle.
The subject's hat brim creates a strong diagonal line that bisects the portrait area.
coreInvariants: Two distinct typographic styles (heavy serif and fluid script)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered in a vertical rectangle that occupies approximately 60% of the total height and 50% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white, all-caps name at the top acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starts at the bold white name, moves to the orange script, and settles on the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space surrounding the central image and text elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for primary display text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Ochre or burnt orange for the script subtitle
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between text and background; muted, naturalistic tones within the photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab-serif and formal copperplate script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses extreme stroke contrast with thick verticals and thin horizontals.
Secondary text uses a continuous, flowing cursive with moderate slant.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned capitals in the primary line
Large, decorative swashes on the initial letters of the script
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, heavy serif with a delicate, organic script.

preserve: All-caps heavy serif for the top line
Cursive script for the second line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme weight and sharp serifs of the primary text.
Captures the elegant, formal cursive quality of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central vertical rectangular portrait of a woman with long dark hair wearing a wide-brimmed felt hat, smiling, in a 1960s film photography style. Place this image in the center of a solid black square background, leaving significant black space at the top for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a top line of text in a heavy, white, all-caps slab-serif font. Below it, add a second line of text in a warm ochre-colored formal script font. Center both lines horizontally.

verificationChecks: Are there two distinct font styles at the top?
Is the photo contained within a clear rectangular frame?
Does the top text use a high-contrast white serif?

mustRedesign: Artist name and specific album title text
The exact facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: The script font is legible against the black background.
The photo frame has sharp, clean edges.
The color of the script matches the warm ochre tone.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central portrait + solid black field + heavy serif header + script subheader = 1960s Folk/Country Aesthetic.
